name: YFG Xerc [Flux | Krea]
description: YFG Xerc Krea – Chromed Exosuits & Biomech Horror Style High-gloss biomechanical aesthetics: reflective chrome armor, segmented exosuits, glowing optics/visors, exposed cables and hydraulics, industrial sparks and neon backlights. Equally at home with heroic, high-tech operatives and ominous cyborg skulls wired with hoses and LEDs. Trigger None. Steer with phrases like “chromed exosuit,” “biomechanical,” “cybernetic skull,” “glowing visor,” “industrial hangar,” “sparks and embers,” or “neon backlight.” Strength Tested 0.30 – 1.00 . Sweet spot ≈ 0.50 for balanced chrome detail and prompt fidelity. Higher values amplify cable clusters, armor plating, glare, and VFX; lower values add subtler biomech accents. Key Characteristics Reflective Armor & Greebles – Mirror-polished plates, ribbed segments, micro-mechanical detailing. Optics & Energy – Bright cyan/red eyes, HUD-like visors, energy arcs, heat bloom. Cable Anatomy – Braided hoses, exposed wiring, servo necks and spines. Industrial Cinematic – Foundry sparks, bokeh neon, moody smoke, steel and gunmetal palettes with cyan/red/orange accents. Armorization – Can “tech-up” non-human subjects: statues, skulls, animals, or props gain plating, lenses, and cables. Prompt Ideas “Close-up cyber-operative in a chromed exosuit, glowing cyan visor, industrial hangar, flying sparks, hyper-detailed.” “Biomechanical skull with red optic cores, braided cables and pistons, moody backlight, dark foundry.” “Futuristic sprinter launching in reflective armor, motion blur and ember trails, neon rim light.” “Ancient statue transformed into a biomech guardian, chrome plating and fiber bundles, teal and orange lighting.” “Portrait with helmeted visor HUD reflections, micro-plating and heat-scored chrome, shallow depth of field.” Tips & Tricks Lighting – Use “neon rim light,” “volumetric smoke,” “backlit sparks,” or “HDR reflections” to sell chrome and glass. Control Intensity – If details get chaotic, drop strength toward 0.4–0.5 or add negatives like “avoid excessive cables,” “no heavy glare.” Color Direction – Specify accent palettes: “steel and gunmetal with cyan highlights” or “black chrome with red optics.” Combine LoRAs – Blend with YFG FaceGear , YFG Daak , or a geometric/lighting LoRA; keep Xerc Krea near 0.5–0.7 so others remain visible. Clean Focus – For readable faces, add “visor transparent,” “face clarity,” or reduce bloom/flare in the prompt. Forge cinematic cyber-aesthetics with YFG Xerc Krea —from gleaming exosuit heroes to terrifying cable-laced automatons—by dialing the strength to match subtle augmentation or full biomechanical intensity.
